live: a button runs `CALL db.schema.visualization()` on the page's database in your browser once its cells have run, and draws the labels and relationship types it reports with the code that draws the figure, beside a table of each label's indexes and constraints.
text: The figure above is the model as written. `CALL db.schema.visualization()` reports the model the page's database holds once the cells have run: one node per label, one relationship per type and pair of labels, and each label's indexes and constraints. When the page was recorded, those cells wrote 11 nodes, 21 relationships, 2 indexes and 3 constraints.
